 Real Betis vs. Malaga - Head-to-head record
 Real Betis have the upper hand in the overall head-to-head record, leading Malaga with 11 wins to eight across 26 meetings in all competitions, with seven draws. Malaga have struggled in this fixture in recent years, losing each of their last four matches against Betis and five of their last six.
 The most recent listed meeting was a 3-1 Malaga victory in a friendly in August 2025, but the competitive encounters before that favoured Betis. The hosts will be keen to extend their recent dominance when the sides meet in Seville.

 Real Betis - Strong overall form
 Here’s a deep dive into Real Betis’s current run of form. We will break down their latest results and discuss what to expect from this important match against Malaga. Towards the end, we’ll also show you the expected Real Betis vs. Malaga line-ups for the game.
 Recent form
 Real Betis have enjoyed an impressive start to the 2026-27 campaign , collecting 20 points from their first ten league matches to sit fourth in the table, seven points behind leaders Barcelona. Manuel Pellegrini’s side have won six, drawn two and lost two of their league games.
 A 5-2 defeat to Barcelona was followed by a goalless draw away to Celta Vigo. However, Betis have been much stronger on home soil, winning four of their five league matches at the Estadio La Cartuja. They have also collected nine points from three Champions League fixtures.
 The hosts will need to manage their squad carefully with another European match against Borussia Dortmund coming up next week. Junior Firpo and Cucho Hernandez are expected to remain unavailable through injury, while Facundo Bernal is suspended.

 Malaga - Still searching for a win
 Let’s review Malaga’s current situation. We will analyse the team’s form, their recent struggles, and standout players for the trip to Seville.
 Recent form
 Malaga have endured a difficult return to the top flight after earning promotion through last season’s Segunda Division play-offs. Juan Francisco Funes’ side sit bottom of La Liga with five points from ten matches , having drawn five and lost five without recording a league victory.
 Their recent league results include a heavy 5-2 defeat at home to Real Sociedad and a 1-1 draw away to Alaves. The team did, however, secure a 3-0 Copa del Rey victory over Sporting Alcázar in midweek, offering some encouragement ahead of a challenging trip to Seville.
 The visitors also have several injury concerns. Juan Cruz, Julen Lobete, Pablo Martinez, Joaquin Munoz, Diego Murillo and Aaron Ochoa are all expected to be unavailable. Adrian Nino should lead the attack after scoring four goals in six La Liga appearances, while Chupe could return to the starting line-up.

 Malaga, however, endures a difficult season, still seeking their first league win and lacking consistency. Given Betis’s tendency for strong starts, betting on the Money Line – Half Time – 1 market for them to lead at the break is a solid option.
